appraisal_events.evidence: Je reçus des marques de froideur de la part d'une autre personne de la maison. Ce fut de Jupien. ... sujet à de brusques mauvaises humeurs, sans raison.
appraisal_events.explanation: Jupien shows the narrator marked coldness in a domestic interaction, but this is promptly explained away by the mother and Françoise as a characterological quirk rather than a targeted rebuke.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator receives a small, quickly-minimized chill from a household figure; a minor, transient exclusion rather than a serious social rupture.

ambiguities: It is unclear whether Jupien's coldness reflects any real judgment of the narrator or is purely characterological (per Françoise's account), which affects how much weight the narrator's mild exclusion should carry.

The duchesse de Guermantes's failure to invite the narrator to see the Elstir paintings could alternatively be read as also snubbing/excluding the narrator directly, but this appears to be the same underlying fact already used by the accepted annotation to diminish Saint-Loup's rhetorical position, so it was not separately scored here to avoid restating that movement.
